job.command:
setenv GSL_RNG_SEED ${JOBINDEX}
echo Sourcing the cshrc source $HOME/.cshrc
# Make sure we are using nfs not afs setup nfs4
# Setup group environment setenv GROUP_DIR /star/u/jeromel/work/STAR/group
# Setup 64 bit w/ spack overlay setup 64b starver SL26x config/v0.3.0-rhel7-root6.24.06
source $GROUP_DIR/star_cshrc.csh
# Setup 64 bit w/ spack overlay setup 64b starver SL26x config/v0.3.0-rhel7-root6.24.06
module load vmc-1-0-p3-root-6.24.06-debug module load geant3-3-9-p1-root-6.24.06-debug module load geant4-10.5.1-debug module load geant4-data-10.5.1-debug module load geant4-vmc-5-0-p5-root-6.24.06-debug module load clhep-2.4.5.1-debug module unload star-table-0.1.1-root-6.24.06 module load star-table-0.1.1-root-6.24.06
mkdir StRoot #cp -R $STAR/StRoot/macros StRoot/
cp -R &MACROSDIR; StRoot/ # cp -R &WORKINGDIR;/.${STAR_HOST_SYS} .
# Ensure that any ROOT5 library is removed from the path setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH `echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH | awk -v RS=: -v ORS=: '/ROOT\/5/ {next} {print}'`
setenv EMYEAR `perl StRoot/macros/embedding/getYearDayFromFile.pl -y ${FILEBASENAME}` setenv EMDAY `perl StRoot/macros/embedding/getYearDayFromFile.pl -d ${FILEBASENAME}` setenv EMRUN `perl StRoot/macros/embedding/getYearDayFromFile.pl -r ${FILEBASENAME}`
echo EMYEAR : $EMYEAR echo EMDAY : $EMDAY echo EMRUN : $EMRUN
mkdir -v $SCRATCH/tags set tagfile=`grep ${FILEBASENAME} &TAGLIST;` cp -v ${tagfile} $SCRATCH/tags/ ls -lah $SCRATCH/ ls -lah $SCRATCH/tags/
touch $SCRATCH/${FILEBASENAME}_${JOBID}.log
cp StRoot/macros/embedding/EmbeddingChainOpts.h . #root.exe -q -b StRoot/macros/embedding/bfcMixer_TpxG4.C'(&NEVENTS;,"'$INPUTFILE0'","'$SCRATCH/tags/${FILEBASENAME}.tags.root'", &PTMN;, &PTMX;, &ETAMN;, &ETAMX;, &VZMN;, &VZMX;, &VRMX;, &PID;, &MULT;, triggers, "&PRODNAME;", "&KINTYPE;",false,"&PIDTYPE;","G4")' >>& $SCRATCH/${FILEBASENAME}_${JOBID}.log root.exe -q -b StRoot/macros/embedding/bfcMixer_TpxG4.C'("P21idIsobar200")'
ls -la .
if ( ! -f &OUTDIR; ) then mkdir -pv &OUTDIR; endif ls -l &OUTDIR;
if ( ! -f &LOGDIR; ) then mkdir -pv &LOGDIR; endif
mv -v $SCRATCH/${FILEBASENAME}_${JOBID}.log &LOGDIR;/${FILEBASENAME}.log
